title: Synthesis --- Two at a Time
label: ch:synthesis-double-object
canDo: I can carry a four-turn exchange in which almost no noun appears.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C47-sintesis-dos-a-la-vez: produce se la hago and say how many words in it name anything.
payoff.note: Three words carrying a person and a thing, neither named. The cost is doubled too: two pronouns are two promises that both things are still in the room.
